title: Holiday Video Maker for Gift Season | AIVideosUGC
description: Use this holiday video maker on one gift photo, then post before the ship date is final. An avatar can hold the product while you add the date later.
h1: Holiday Video Maker for a Festive Gift Ad
lead: This holiday video maker lets the gift ad go up before the ship-by date is set. An avatar can hold the gift, and you type the date when the carrier confirms it.

faq.q: How do credits work for a holiday photo or video?
faq.a: A photo spends 24 credits. A video spends 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits, Pro is $35 with 300, and Premium is $63 with 600. You see the cost before the job runs, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Can I add a holiday song and seasonal pictures?
faq.a: Yes. Choose a track from the music library, add seasonal pictures, and put captions on in the editor. Use a track you are allowed to play.

faq.q: Can I make holiday scenes for many products at once?
faq.a: Yes. Run several product links in a batch, and each one comes back as its own gift scene. You still check every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can an AI avatar deliver the gift message?
faq.a: Yes. An AI avatar from the library of 53 can read a short gift note beside the product. Keep the product easy to recognize.

faq.q: Can I use the file again after the holiday?
faq.a: You keep the file you downloaded. Change the date, the voice, or the offer in the editor, and use the scene again for the next holiday.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link?
faq.a: Yes. Open the product page and use that photo as the gift in the scene. If the page photo is too tight, upload a clear shot you already sell with.

faq.q: Can I publish my holiday video to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook?
faq.a: Yes. Download the file, or send it to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook yourself. You still choose the budget in that ad account.

faq.q: Can I create holiday ads through an API?
faq.a: Yes. Your tools can ask for a holiday ad from a product link through the API. You approve the file before anyone else sees it.
